purpose: Capture-era orientation of raw-variant materials for tools/prepare_museum_review.py.
limits: transposed lists the captured materials whose stored images are the transpose of the published export (map_materials converts column_major_raw sources to row-major; the capture did not). This is the recorded capture orientation the shipped review uses, not a claim about native presentation.
